name: Classic Packaging Company
old_description: Our top-of-the-line technologies allow us to offer a wide variety of packaging configurations and options to retailers, food processors, and packaging distributors across the nation. We design the best packaging solutions to your packaging needs.
about:
Classic Packaging Company operates from Pfafftown, North Carolina, where it has been family-owned and operated since its founding in 1991. The company began as a flexible packaging provider focused on delivering high-quality plastic packaging solutions to retailers, food processors, and distributors nationwide.

The company specializes in flexographic printing, laminating, coating, slitting, pouching, and bag making, supported by pre-press services and in-house lab testing. Its production floor runs 10-color PCMC flexographic presses with AVT 100% inspection, solventless single-component laminators from Nordmechanica and Comexi, and servo-driven pouch lines equipped with leak testers on every station. Additional capabilities include the Hudson-Sharp EZ-Stand system for pre-gusseted stand-up pouches and the INNO-LOK pre-zippered fastener application.

Classic Packaging serves retailers, food processors, and packaging distributors across the United States. Its food-grade, FDA-approved packaging is used for frozen foods, snacks, sweets, pet foods, frozen poultry, baking mixes, frozen vegetables, frozen seafood, and coffee. The company also supplies packaging distributors who resell its bags and pouches to end users.

The company states its mission is to create business relationships where all participants prosper, emphasizing honesty, integrity, a safe workplace, and environmental stewardship. It differentiates itself through continuous technological investment, rigorous quality control during lamination and printing, and proprietary equipment configurations that enable faster filling speeds and reduced waste.
